observations: Transformers reported quant_method modelopt as unknown and skipped the quantization adapter.
Packed down_proj tensors had shape [64, 2048, 2560] while differentiable modules expected [64, 2048, 5120].
Packed up_proj tensors had shape [64, 5120, 1024] while differentiable modules expected [64, 5120, 2048].
MTP tensors were reported as unexpected by the differentiable Nemotron-H loader.
The loader attempted to reinitialize mismatched tensors and terminated with CUDA out of memory before any forward pass.
replacement_reason: NVIDIA's aligned BF16 sibling preserves the target model while exposing standard differentiable weights.
